finding.title: Struct equality on Option for stale check
finding.message: The stale-check compares Option structs with ==, but Option contains fields that may be non-comparable (e.g., func fields such as Closable-related or other members in the truncated struct). If Option has any uncomparable field this fails to compile; also any change to the item (label, badge) silently revokes selection which may be intended but is fragile.
finding.suggestion: Compare only the relevant fields explicitly (ID, Disabled, Label) rather than whole-struct equality.
